_about: Why a grown-up's "?" goes up: the bubble over them (bubble) and the reason in the HUD line when Heat rises (heat, after the grown-up's name: 'A Shelf stacker saw you running'). One reason per kind of suspicious thing the suspicion system knows (src/systems/suspicion.js).

near.bubble: Why is that grown-up so... short?
near.heat: got a good look at you

carry.bubble: What on earth is he carrying?

map.bubble: Who reads a map in a supermarket?
map.heat: saw you hiding behind a map

unstack.bubble: Did that coat just... come apart?

spill.bubble: Was that a CHILD falling out?!
spill.heat: saw a kid fall out of your coat

heatLevels: PANIC! The front doors are locked: the back door by the yard still works.
